evade.label: Don't get hit
evade.desc: Make enemy attacks against you (or an ally) miss more often.

mitigate.label: Take less when hit
mitigate.desc: Reduce or absorb the damage that does land.

land-hits.label: Land your attacks
land-hits.desc: Raise your own attack accuracy, or soften a target so it's easier to hit.

target-softening.label: Boons vs / control on the target

boost-damage.label: Hit harder
boost-damage.desc: Add to the damage of your weapon / unarmed attacks. Flat and dice bonuses add up.

suppress-enemy.label: Blunt the enemy
suppress-enemy.desc: Cut an enemy's offense: banes on its rolls, or deny its actions outright.

combos.rationale: Raise Defense + Banes on attacks vs you: two different levers on “don't get hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Raise Defense + Concealment / hard to target: two different levers on “don't get hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Banes on attacks vs you + Concealment / hard to target: two different levers on “don't get hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Reduce incoming damage + Extra / temporary Health: two different levers on “take less when hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Reduce incoming damage + In-fight healing: two different levers on “take less when hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Extra / temporary Health + In-fight healing: two different levers on “take less when hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Banes on its rolls + Stun / immobilize / slow: two different levers on “blunt the enemy”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.
Boons to land the unarmed strike plus stacked extra damage on it: accuracy and damage on the same attack, the brawler's core.
Every one of these adds extra damage to unarmed/natural-weapon attacks, and extra-damage dice add together — a brawler can layer them all onto the same punch.
Multiple sources of raise defense. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of concealment / hard to target. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of reduce incoming damage. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of extra / temporary health. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of in-fight healing. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of extra weapon/unarmed damage. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of stun / immobilize / slow. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.
Multiple sources of banes on attacks vs you. Boons/banes pool to the single highest die, so each extra source after the first barely moves the needle — spend the casting on a different lever instead.
Multiple sources of boons on your attacks. Boons/banes pool to the single highest die, so each extra source after the first barely moves the needle — spend the casting on a different lever instead.
Multiple sources of banes on its rolls. Boons/banes pool to the single highest die, so each extra source after the first barely moves the needle — spend the casting on a different lever instead.

control.name: Mad Piping of the Outer Dark

notes.boons_banes: Boons and banes on one roll pool together and only the single highest d6 applies (E[max]: 1d6=3.5, 2d6=4.47, 3d6=4.96). Stacking the same roll-lever diminishes fast.
notes.flat_bonuses: Flat Defense bonuses and extra-damage dice add together, so stacking the same flat lever is linear and worth it.
notes.compounding: The strongest combos pair different levers toward one goal (e.g. raise Defense AND impose banes on attacks against you): each avoids the other's diminishing returns.
notes.precast: Minute+/hour buffs can be cast before the fight, so they cost no action economy once combat starts. Holding 2+ concentration spells is fragile: taking damage forces a challenge roll to keep each.
